sentences.text: In the complaint it is averred that complainant's minor daughter, aged about 17 years got married to the petitioner in the month of May - 2022 and was residing with him.
Subsequently, complainant's minor daughter got pregnant and thereafter, the complainant and her family members were visiting the matrimonial house of her daughter.
On 18.05.2023, complainant's daughter suffered from labour pain and therefore, she was taken to Jayanagara General Hospital and thereafter, to a private hospital.
In the said hospital, at about 6.30 p.m., the complainant's daughter gave birth to a male child.

5. Learned counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition submits that even as per the complaint averments, complainant was aware of the marriage between the petitioner and her daughter.
The complaint was lodged belatedly, after the victim girl gave birth to a male child.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
In her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C., the victim girl has not supported the case of the prosecution.

Accordingly, prays to allow the petition.
6.
Learned counsel for the de-facto complainant has not seriously opposed the bail application.
Learned HCGP has opposed the bail application and submits that the victim was a minor at the time of her marriage and therefore, prays to dismiss the petition.
From the material on record it is seen that the complainant was aware of the marriage between the petitioner and the victim girl, which was allegedly performed in the month of May - 2022.

Thereafter, complainant's minor daughter was residing along with the petitioner in his house and the complainant and her family members were also visiting the house of the petitioner after they came to know that their daughter was pregnant.
On 18.05.2023, after the complainant's daughter received labour pain, she was admitted to the hospital and on the said date at about 6.30 p.m., she gave birth to a male child.
Thereafter, on the next day, the complainant had approached the police and lodged the complaint.
Petitioner, who has no criminal antecedents, is in custody since 19.06.2023.
Investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet has been filed.
Victim girl has not supported the case of the prosecution during her statement recorded under Section 164 of Cr.P.C.
Petitioner's custody is no more required since charge sheet has already filed in this case.
Complainant has not seriously opposed the bail application.
Under these circumstances, I am of the view that the petitioner's prayer for NC: 2023:KHC:33721 grant of regular bail is required to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER
The petition is allowed.
